title: Split algebraic-space deformation tensor coefficients
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $X$ an algebraic space over $\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Use the small affine ringed model and its actual regular-functions sheaf $\mathcal O_X$ [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model]. For a $K$-vector space $M$, define $G_M$ as the sheafification of the presheaf $U\mapsto\mathcal O_X(U)\otimes_K M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], with the field action pulled back along the chart structure morphism. Restriction is the unique semilinear map $s\otimes m\mapsto s|_V\otimes m$; these maps satisfy identity and composition. A linear map $h:M\to N$ gives section maps $1\otimes h$, which commute with restriction, and hence the sheaf map $G_h:G_M\to G_N$. Use the existing representable terminal base and its unique structure map $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}K$ [def-sfb-space-marked-split-module-deformations]. With the naive cotangent complex and derived conventions of [def-sfb-space-naive-cotangent-complex], put $E^n_X(M)=\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathrm{NL}_{X/K},G_M)$; its coefficient map for $h$ is postcomposition by $G_h[n]$. No finite dimension or quasi-coherence condition on $M$ is imposed.
